pr_body_excerpt:

- # 📊 Intelligent Diagnostic Assessment A revolutionary AI-powered tool to transform diagnostic educational assessment [![Powered by Pollinations.ai](https://img.shields.io/badge/Powered%20by-Pollinati

gist.headline: A smarter pop quiz
gist.blurb: The learn garden has a new resident: an AI-powered diagnostic assessment that helps map what a student already knows before the lesson begins. Less guesswork, more useful next steps.
gist.summary: Added Intelligent Diagnostic Assessment to the learn app collection, giving educators and students an AI-powered tool for identifying learning needs before instruction.
gist.impact: Learners can now use the Intelligent Diagnostic Assessment to get a clearer starting-point evaluation and guide their next study steps.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a thoughtful teacher bee wearing tiny round glasses and holding a clipboard beside a cozy classroom terminal. The terminal displays a friendly diagnostic quiz with simple checkmarks and growing knowledge-plants; a few flowers bloom from completed answers to show assessment becoming a personalized learning path.
